verdict_reason: The role filter, its narrowing of q and countryCode, paging over filtered results and the unknown-role 400 are each pinned by a test that fails without the change, but the role-holding address set-up is copied across four IT classes instead of living in IntegrationBase.

todos.issue: Saving an active address of the caller's organisation holding given roles is set-up used by four IT classes, each with its own copy: the private saveActiveAddressWithRoles(name, countryCode, roles...) here (AddressListIT.java:59), inline addressBuilder(...).roles(List.of(...)) in AddressRepositoryIT.java:101-142, londonDepot().name(...).roles(List.of(...)) nine times in AddressSearchIT.java:253-320, and saveActiveAddressWithRolesAndOptionals in AddressUpdateIT.java:26. integration.md: set-up used by two IT classes goes in IntegrationBase and the local copies are deleted.
todos.fix: Must: one shared helper in IntegrationBase saves an address holding the given roles, and AddressListIT, AddressSearchIT, AddressRepositoryIT and AddressUpdateIT call it with no local copies left. One way: promote saveActiveAddressWithRoles to IntegrationBase as a builder step (e.g. addressHolding(org, status, roles...)) and replace the inline .roles(List.of(...)) chains.
